changes: Desktop app blank-screen fixes: correct CORS for Vite module scripts, serve /assets correctly, and stop returning index.html for missing JS/CSS files
Packaging scripts updated for Vite (VITE_API_URL); rebuild HRMini.exe with the current frontend
Error boundary added so UI crashes show a clear message instead of a blank page
Holiday Management: upload holidays from Excel instead of entering them one by one, with a downloadable template
Excel columns are Date and Name, plus optional Company, Active, and Union Only. A blank Company uses the company selected in the upload dialog
Holiday dates that already exist for that company are skipped, and rows that cannot be imported are listed
Attendance CSV upload previews each row before import, showing valid, invalid, and duplicate counts
Attendance preview explains a missing employee ID (including a matching ID when the name is found), an invalid date, or a record that already exists
Blank or dash punch times in an attendance CSV are treated as empty

Work Permit Management redesigned as an overview registry: Valid / Expiring Soon / Expired summary cards, searchable table of current permits with days remaining, and a detail panel with full permit history and Renew, Edit and Delete
Add Work Permit is always available and lets you pick the employee in the form; permits now also record permit number, issue date and notes
Leave Dashboard, Work Schedules, Attendance, Termination and HR Reports pages rebuilt on the new design (HR Reports is now a two-pane report studio)
Administration pages (Company, Payroll Periods, Holidays, Users, Code Maintenance, About) share one consistent layout with search, filters, record counts and confirmation dialogs
Code Maintenance: choose the code list from a dropdown, ready for more lists to be added
Left menu sub-sections start collapsed after sign-in
New user interface: the app is rebuilt on shadcn/ui and Tailwind CSS, with a refreshed look across the login page, dashboard and navigation
Collapsible left sidebar with grouped sections: Overview, People & Lifecycle, Time, Pay & Claims, Reports and Administration (Ctrl+B to collapse)
Payroll Dashboard: legend filters, two-month calendar view and event tooltips; company filter moved to the top bar
Reports (HR Reports, Audit Report) now have their own menu section; Payroll Periods moved to Administration
Session timeout: the sign-in token now lasts 45 minutes so the 'Session Expiring Soon' warning can always extend the session; the idle logout is still 30 minutes
Session warning dialog redesigned
Faster startup and builds (moved from Create React App to Vite)
About page with version, release date and change history
Code Maintenance page (System Management) for Employee Type, Wage Classification, Department and Position
Employment Management: Employee Type, Department and Position are now dropdowns; company ID shown in the Company dropdown and table
Wage Classification moved from Employment Management to Salary Management
Work permit expiry dates shown on the dashboard calendar; Work Permit Alerts section removed
Employee Information: summary boxes filter the list when clicked; Terminated box removed
Employee Information: default view is Active & Probation; terminated staff can be found with the status filter
Employee search matches full names, and terminated staff stay visible under their last company
Single-exe desktop packaging (HRMini.exe)
Leave, attendance and reporting updates
